title: bev_fusion: camera + radar BEV system in five layers
subtitle: Built 2026-11-01 (Mirko's layered design). Left of the input interface nothing learns; between the two interfaces every slot is a swappable block chosen in ModelConfig (one builder table per slot, tests/test_slots.py) with no rule step; right of the output interface only the selection of boxes and line cells for the metrics, and later the planner.

pre.label: precompute: deterministic, cached with an identity, no weights learned before it

interface.label: interface: one typed contract (names, shapes, units, frames)

nodes.label:
Cameras
now + past frames
nodes.note: today the front camera; six cameras are one more entry of the interface, not a new chain

nodes.label:
Radars
detections, 0.5 s
nodes.note: all five radars

nodes.label:
Ego motion
poses / CAN
nodes.note: from the poses in nuScenes; a deployed system supplies its own odometry

nodes.label:
Image features
frozen encoder, cached
nodes.note: frozen DualBEV / BEVFusion image heads: depth probabilities + context per pixel; while frozen they are a cache (with a meta.json identity), once unfrozen the image encoder becomes the first network slot

nodes.label:
Radar points to now
pose + Doppler, cached
nodes.note: the sweeps of 0.5 s compensated to the current time and cached as points (not as a grid): the radar slot keeps the choice of raster or point encoder

nodes.label:
Ego steps, calibration
(dt, v, omega), K, T
nodes.note: the ego step from every past frame to now (dataset, from the poses), calibration and crop, the radar poses, and the ego steps to the neighbouring keyframes (batch['gap_steps']: the true gap to the target time and the memory step between calls, from the poses; train.batch_ego / clip_step read them, so the network runs without GT)

nodes.label:
INPUT INTERFACE
BEVInputs (typed dict + check): image features, lane image, K, T, ida, radar points, ego steps, gaps, flip
nodes.note: BEVInputs = the batch dict with its contract in interface.INPUTS (names, shapes, units, frames) and check_inputs(); the forward arguments dts, state, step, ego in interface.CALL; the per-sample flip flag travels with it (the mirror is a BEV operation after the camera slot)

nodes.label:
Camera BEV encoder
lift + collapse; mirror in BEV
nodes.note: contract: BEVInputs -> (BEVs (B, F, C_cam, X, Y), visibility (B, 1, X, Y)), mirrored in BEV for flipped samples (cached perspective features cannot be mirrored); kinds dualbev, bevfusion, dual

nodes.label:
Radar BEV encoder
raster + convs | pillars | off
nodes.note: contract: radar points -> (B, C_rad, X, Y); the raster is the first op, before any weight, so it costs no gradient; radar history is the sweeps inside the points

nodes.label:
Temporal fusion
per branch: camera, radar
nodes.note: the same block for both branches (TemporalFusion takes channels and grid); camera: window + world memory; radar: none today, world memory as the first arm (its 0.5 s history is in the points); contract: (BEV now, past BEVs with their ego steps, state, step since the last call, coverage) -> (BEV, state); the re-centre is a whole-cell roll, the gradient passes; finding (tests/test_slots.py): with no past radar frames the window part and the velocity head of the radar block get no gradient, so the radar memory needs its own static gate (the measured Doppler) or past radar BEVs

nodes.label:
Fusion
concat | gate
nodes.note: contract: (camera BEV, radar BEV) -> (B, C_fuse, X, Y); modality dropout lives here (off when a sensor is off)

nodes.label:
BEV backbone + neck
ResNet + FPN | SECOND | CMX
nodes.note: contract: (B, C_fuse, X, Y) -> features S (B, C, X, Y), the optional 1x1 head reduction included; CMX replaces fusion and backbone together (a kind of this slot that takes both branch BEVs)

nodes.label:
Time mover
velocity + ego splat
nodes.note: the shared TimeMover: moves S to each target time dt (velocity head + ego splat) before both heads, gives v_hat at dt 0

nodes.label:
Map head
layers per dt
nodes.note: contract: (S moved to dt) -> map probabilities (B, L, X, Y); the aux heads read the branch BEVs, not S (training only)

nodes.label:
Object head
CenterPoint maps per dt
nodes.note: contract: (S moved to dt) -> heatmap, offset, size, yaw, velocity, moving maps; the refiner (option, off in the base chain) decodes top-k and matches the GT inside the training path: a rule step when it is on

nodes.label:
Planner (later)
after the system
nodes.note: a consumer of the output interface, not part of the system; the outputs are dense and differentiable, so a later joint training lets its loss flow back into the fusion

nodes.label:
OUTPUT INTERFACE
maps, object maps per dt, v_hat, features S, state
nodes.note: BEVOutputs = per dt the maps, the object maps, the dense boxes and the soft line map (interface.OUTPUTS_PER_DT / OPTIONAL_PER_DT, check_outputs), plus v_hat, the features S and the temporal state

nodes.label:
Line cells
threshold
nodes.note: thresholds the soft line map for the line metric; the metric's reference line_cells stays the definition and a test checks the two agree

nodes.label:
Select boxes
local max, top-k, threshold
nodes.note: select_boxes: the post-processing of model.boxes(); the evaluation adapter still scores with object_head.decode (equal box for box, extract.py self-test), so both stay until the adapter reads select_boxes

nodes.label:
Trainer + slot tables
check_config
nodes.note: ModelConfig picks one kind per slot from the builder tables of model.py (LIFTS, COLLAPSES, TEMPORALS, RADARS, FUSIONS, BACKBONES); check_config refuses every unknown kind and unfitting combination in one place

nodes.label:
Loss
BEVLoss + Kendall
nodes.note: one module: the Kendall weights and the cross-head terms (motion and time consistency, refine) stay together; heads declare their output keys

nodes.label:
Lane add-on (option)
stride 4, after temporal
nodes.note: reads the lane image, K, T, ida and the DualBEV depth of the current frame; its BEV is added to the camera BEV after the temporal block; mirrored on its own

nodes.label:
Soft extraction
peaks, box params, line map
nodes.note: built from today's decode and line extraction: per cell a peak weight (heatmap x exp(-beta (maxpool - heatmap))), the box parameters (centre with offset, size, yaw with a soft direction sign, velocity x sigmoid(moving)) and a soft line map (near-zero distance x soft local minimum); fixed math, differentiable

nodes.label:
Visibility maps
camera, radar fan, fusion area
nodes.note: the precompute step (precompute.py): vis_cam from calibration + grid (cached per calibration, the same function live), vis_radar = the radar fans of the calibrated poses (D36; autogt.coverage.radar_cells, cached per rig), vis_fusion = camera x radar (D37: fusion results are scored there), radar_hits = cells with detections now (the radar memory's write mask), radar_static = the same weighted by the measured Doppler (the write mask with rad_static_gate); read by the network, the training (D36 loss masks) and the evaluation (scoring masks)

groups.label: 3 network: one slot per block, the kind chosen in ModelConfig, a contract test per kind

not_drawn.training/motion_block.py: t12 experiment: the velocity field from two camera BEVs, ego motion and the radar Doppler; trained alone on a frozen base (train_motion_block.py), not part of the main chain until it wins its card
not_drawn.training/train_motion_block.py: t12 experiment trainer of the motion block on a frozen, trained base model; not the main training
not_drawn.training/startable.py: tool: static checks, smoke config and start lines of a training config; no GPU, not part of the network
not_drawn.training/temporal.py: older multi-hypothesis temporal propagation, superseded by temporal_fusion.py; imported only by tests and scratch
not_drawn.training/radar_encoder.py: delta-coded slot raster of plan 3.4, not imported by model.py or train.py
not_drawn.training/legacy: S1 single-sensor pipeline and the t4 DualBEV front; nothing in model / train / evaluation imports it
